population_basis: global, true injected slice, true slice complement; not diagnosed-slice guarantees

evidence_quality.origin: Guide v1.1 evidence-quality formula; heuristic, not calibrated failure probability

adaptive_candidates: twenty tuples with LOW buffer <= MEDIUM buffer <= HIGH buffer
operational_rule: AUTO_DEPLOY signal requires all hard gates PASS, supported N2, N3 all SAFE and min_target(lower - unchanged_boundary) >= context buffer; otherwise preserve N3 ESCALATE or HUMAN_REVIEW
guide_difference: Guide example parameters 0.08/0.12/0.18 were not applied by its decision function. This specification introduces an explicit additional accuracy-margin buffer; grid is an investigator-defined design choice, not a fitted or guide-derived quantity.

selection.unsafe_definition: at least one observed primary margin strictly below its unchanged safety boundary
selection.conditional_unsafe_statistic: mean over groups with AUTO_DEPLOY of unsafe AUTO_DEPLOY count divided by AUTO_DEPLOY count in that group
selection.automation_statistic: mean over nonempty admitted groups of AUTO_DEPLOY count divided by admitted scenario count
selection.objective: maximize group-averaged automation among eligible candidates; tie-break by lower empirical unsafe rate, then lexicographically larger buffer tuple
selection.adaptive_context_support: contexts represented by fewer than 3 admitted policy groups must always HUMAN_REVIEW; N3 or gate ESCALATE still takes precedence
selection.no_eligible_candidate: save unsupported-selection status and use review-only policy for N3-safe/uncertain cases; retain mandatory escalation
selection.risk_claim: empirical screening criterion only, not a finite-sample 95% bound on conditional deployment risk
selection.design_choices: buffer grid, minimum support and empirical risk ceiling fixed here before policy outcomes; no claim these are optimal
